howWeWork.title: How we work
paragraphs: We eliminate the handoff between design and engineering. Product strategy, UX, and development sit on one team — so decisions stay connected from day one and nothing gets lost in translation.
We work systems-first: reusable components, clear architecture, and maintainable code your team can extend long after launch. Every build is structured for scale, not just for demo day.
Engagements run in focused 2–8 week sprints with weekly demos. You see real progress early, give feedback often, and ship with confidence — not surprises at the finish line.

story.title: Built by Engineers Who Care About Outcomes
paragraphs: 360GrowthCloudTech started with a simple frustration: businesses were paying for software that looked good in demos but did not fit how they worked, and they were stuck juggling designers, developers and hosting providers who blamed each other when things went wrong.

So we built a different kind of software development company. Product strategy, UX design, engineering, testing, cloud and support sit in one team, so decisions stay connected from the first workshop to long after launch. We work in short sprints with weekly demos, explain trade-offs in plain language and measure success by what the software does for your business.

Today we build <services>custom software, web and mobile apps, SaaS platforms and business systems</services> for startups, SMEs and enterprises across healthcare, fintech, travel, retail, education, real estate and more. See the results in our <work>case studies</work>.

faqs.title: About 360GrowthCloudTech
faqs.subtitle: Common questions about who we are and how we work.

items.a: We are a software development company that designs, builds and supports custom software, web and mobile apps, SaaS platforms, websites, business systems such as CRM and inventory software, and cloud and AI solutions.
Our team is based in India and works remotely with clients across India and worldwide, with meetings scheduled in each client's time zone.

items.q: What size of businesses do you work with?
items.a: We work with startups launching their first product, small and medium businesses digitising their operations, and enterprises modernising or extending their systems.

items.q: Do you work only with technical clients?
items.a: No. Many of our clients are non-technical founders and business owners. We guide you through every decision in plain language.

items.q: How do we start working together?
items.a: Book a free 30-minute consultation. We learn about your goals, recommend the right approach and share a transparent estimate, usually within 48 hours.
